description:
Contractors must be certified through Defense Logistics Information Services’ (DLIS) Joint Certification Program in order to access Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or Export Controlled information in Contract Opportunities. See the DLA website for the Joint Certification Program:
https://www.dla.mil/HQ/LogisticsOperations/Services/JCP/.

 Naval Research Laboratory (NRL)   Tactical Electronic Warfare Divison Code 5700 has the requirement for the procurement of Aluminum parts, fabrication for transportation frame.

For additional details on the submission of quotes, please see the attached Combined Synopsis/Solicitation N00173-26-Q-1301357113 and Attachment 1 – Drawings, which is issued in accordance with FAR Subparts 13.5 and 12.6.
